thread:
mia: onboarding demo blocked — js-sdk fncall + JSON_MODE returned array elements as escaped JSON strings; zod validation failed.

ryan: can you paste raw model output and what the validator actually received? even a short example helps.

mia: raw model output:
```json
{"hits":[{"name":"x","score":0.8},{"name":"y","score":0.7}]}
```
what arrived at validator after sdk sanitizer:
```json
{"hits":["{\"name\":\"x\",\"score\":0.8}","{\"name\":\"y\",\"score\":0.7}"]}
```

leo: looks like the sanitizer stringified object elements inside arrays. which sdk version?

mia: js-sdk v0.10.4, only when using the function-call helper path with JSON_MODE=1. python sample app did not reproduce.

ryan: pragmatic stopgap: add an opt-in env var SANITIZE_PARSE_ARRAY_ELEMS=true that will attempt JSON.parse on array member strings if they look like JSON (trim starts with "{" or "[") and are under 8192 bytes. record telemetry event "sanitizer.parse_array_elem" with outcome "success"/"fail" and sdk_version.

leo: prefer opt-in for now to avoid parsing prose with braces. add unit tests for mixed arrays (numbers, plain strings, object-strings) and ensure top-level stringified-object remains a string.

ci-bot: CI queued for commit 7a1f... (job 9021)

mia: branch pushed with tests and docs: github.com/redwood-inference/sample-apps/gh-340-parse-array-elems. demo docker-compose sets SANITIZE_PARSE_ARRAY_ELEMS=true so onboarding doesn't hit this friction.

leo: small nit — include a size/time guard and only parse when parse completes quickly. avoid blocking flows.

ryan: added a 50ms fastfail on parse and a size guard in the PR. will also emit parse_time_ms in telemetry.

eng-bot: CI passed for PR 632 (job 9021) :white_check_mark:. release build scheduled for release/0.10.5.

mia: thanks all. follow-up: monitor telemetry for 14 days and decide whether to flip default. opened issue #3388 to track the decision. closing the loop. :party-parrot:
